method: FingerGAN generator (Zhu, Yin & Hu, TPAMI 2023) fine-tuned from the released weights on our MSU-normalised damaged -> clean pairs (v3), non-adversarial (L1 + clDice)
_normalization: input = normalize(degraded) /255; target = the normalised clean print /255 (the generator's sigmoid range), so the output is a normalised print, measured as stored (evaluate.py --rec-normalized)
_weights: the starting point, relative to experiments/baselines/E03_fingergan/
_inference: window, step, batch as E03 (the authors' defaults)

training.data: E19's NormPairs at 192 px: FixedTrainDataset(normalized=True) windows on v3 (113,544 samples), centred on damage 90% of the time
training._why: no discriminator was released, so no adversarial term; L1 pulls the output into the normalised-print domain the evaluator compares, clDice (E07's cldice_term, inside the dilated mask, weight 0.1) asks for connected ridges in the damage. lr 5e-5: a small step from the released weights; 6k steps x 16 windows = 96k windows, under one pass of the train set

run_if: E17's val sweep: the selected variant's net rescue has its 95% CI upper end below 0 (FingerGAN still fails zero-shot); chain.sh checks this before training
